comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Moeraki Boulders

Further Research Quest name: Further Research into the Large Round Stone
Skill requirement: r12 Recognition, r14 Geography, CHN(Chinese)
Pre-requisite discovery: Concretion discovery (from "Round Large Boulders" quest) + Aotearoa discovery (from "Long white clouds" quest)
Required Sophia rank: 4
Sophia cost: 400 points
